steps.title: Harvest and count cells
steps.instruction: Harvest fresh culture(s) at room temperature, count cells and use 5 × 10⁴–1 × 10⁶ mammalian cells per sample (or a homogeneous suspension of intact tissue cells).

steps.title: Wash cells three times
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 600 × g for 3 min at room temperature, discard supernatant, resuspend in 1.5 mL room‑temperature Wash Buffer, transfer to a 2 mL tube if needed, centrifuge again (600 × g, 3 min, RT) and discard supernatant. Repeat the 1.5 mL‑resuspend/centrifuge step two more times (total three washes). Finally resuspend in 1 mL room‑temperature Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Bind cells to ConA beads
steps.instruction: While gently vortexing the cell suspension at room temperature, add the Concanavalin A‑coated bead suspension, invert vigorously to obtain a homogeneous bead‑bound cell suspension, aliquot into 0.6 mL low‑bind tubes (one tube per antibody), and place on a tube nutator at room temperature for 5–10 min.

steps.title: Magnet clear bead suspension
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on a magnetic stand, allow beads to collect, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add primary antibody
steps.instruction: Place each tube at a low angle on a vortex mixer set to low (~1100 rpm), squirt 150 µL Antibody Buffer along the side while gently vortexing to dislodge beads, tap to release remaining beads, then add primary antibody to a final dilution of 1:100 (or the manufacturer’s recommended IF concentration). Include a positive control (e.g., anti‑H3K27me3) and a negative control (e.g., anti‑mouse IgG). Nutate at room temperature for 2 h (or incubate overnight at 4 °C). After incubation, give a quick pulse spin on a micro‑centrifuge (≤100 × g) to minimize carry‑over.

steps.title: Wash with Digitonin Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL Digitonin Buffer to each tube, mix by inversion or gentle pipetting, place on the magnetic stand, clear (~30 s) and discard supernatant. Repeat this wash two more times (total three washes).

steps.title: Add secondary antibody (if needed)
steps.instruction: Place each tube at a low angle on the vortex mixer (low, ~1100 rpm), add 150 µL Digitonin Buffer, then add secondary antibody to a final dilution of 1:100. Nutate at 4 °C for ~1 h or overnight.

steps.title: Prepare pA‑MNase solution
steps.instruction: Mix pA‑MNase to a final concentration of ~700 ng mL⁻¹ in Digitonin Buffer (prepare 4.5 mL per 24 reactions). Transfer the solution to a reservoir and dispense 175 µL into each active well of a labeled V‑Bottom plate (position P4 on the Biomek deck).

steps.title: Load bead‑bound cells onto Biomek
steps.instruction: Using wide‑bore 200 µL tips, resuspend the ConA‑bead‑bound cells + antibodies, array them into a PCR 96‑Well plate (position P6), and record sample positions. Place fresh AP96 200 µL tips at TL1, the ALPAQUA Magnet Plate at P3, and an empty Deep‑Well plate for waste at P9.

steps.title: Bind pA‑MNase to antibodies
steps.instruction: Start the pA‑MNase Binding Method on the Biomek: add 50 µL pA‑MNase Reaction Mix (prepared above) to each well containing bead‑bound cells + antibodies, keep the plate on a cooling block set to 0 °C (position P10), and mix for 1 h on the nutator. During this hour, prepare 4 X Stop Buffer (25 µL per sample) and keep on ice.

steps.title: Digest chromatin with MNase
steps.instruction: After the 1‑h binding, set a pause for the desired digestion time (9–30 min) and then add 25 µL 4 X Stop Buffer to each well. The digestion proceeds at room temperature; longer times increase yield but may raise background for some antibodies.

steps.title: End‑repair and A‑tailing
steps.instruction: Add 12.5 µL 4 X End Repair/A‑Tailing (ERA) buffer to each well (final 1×), mix by pipetting up/down 5 times, seal the plate with an adhesive cover and place in a pre‑cooled thermocycler (12 °C) for the programmed ERA incubation.

steps.title: Adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Thaw 0.15 µM pre‑annealed TruSeq adapters on ice. Add 5 µL adapter to each well, mix by pipetting up/down 5 times. Add 50 µL 2 X Rapid Ligase solution, mix by pipetting up/down 10 times, seal the plate and incubate at 20 °C for 20 min. Proceed immediately to Proteinase K digestion (not detailed here).

steps.title: First Ampure cleanup (pre‑PCR)
steps.instruction: Spin the PCR 96‑Well plate containing adapter‑ligated DNA at 2,000 rpm for 1 min, remove the seal, and add 90 µL Ampure Bead slurry to each well. Mix, incubate, place on the magnetic stand, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 1 mL 80 % ethanol (dispensed into a Deep‑Well plate at P4), and elute DNA in 100 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8 (plate at P2). Perform a second identical Ampure cleanup on the eluate before PCR.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare 4.5 mL of 20 % PEG 8000, 2.5 M NaCl (HXP Mix) for up to 24 reactions; dispense 100 µL into each well of a V‑Bottom plate (position P7). Keep all reagents on ice. Prepare KAPA PCR Master Mix (20 µL per sample) and keep on ice.

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL KAPA PCR Master Mix to each well of the clean DNA plate (position P8), mix by pipetting up/down 10 times, seal with an adhesive cover, and run a thermocycler program with 12–14 cycles, using a combined 60 °C annealing/extension step of 10 s per cycle (heated lid >20 °C).

steps.title: Second Ampure cleanup (post‑PCR)
steps.instruction: Spin the PCR plate at 2,000 rpm for 1 min, remove seal, add 55 µL Ampure Bead slurry to each well, mix, incubate, magnetically separate, wash twice with 1 mL 80 % ethanol (plate at P4), and elute cleaned library DNA in 100 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8 (plate at P2).

steps.title: Library quality control
steps.instruction: Determine library size distribution using an Agilent 4200 TapeStation, quantify library yield with a dsDNA‑specific assay (e.g., Qubit), and pool indexed libraries at equimolar concentrations.

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Pool up to 24 barcoded libraries per lane, perform paired‑end 25 × 25 bp Illumina sequencing (5 million paired‑end reads per sample is sufficient). Single‑end sequencing is not recommended.

steps.title: Data analysis
steps.instruction: Align paired‑end reads with Bowtie2 v2.2.5 using: --local --very-sensitive-local --no-unal --no-mixed --no-discordant --phred33 -I 10 -X 700 (add --no-overlap --no-dovetail for spike‑in mapping). Separate fragments ≤120 bp and ≥150 bp for downstream analysis.
